repo_notes.content: このWikiではリレー（連動装置・RendoTable・進路/てこ/鎖錠のリレー処理）とTTC（列番窓・TtcWindow・TtcController）について説明しないこと。これらのクラス・CSV・テーブルに言及するページやセクションを作らないこと。

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: Introduce the Traincrew MultiATS Server, explaining it's a multi-user railway automatic train supervision system with real-time interlocking logic, train management, and centralized traffic control capabilities

pages.title: Train Operations Management
pages.purpose: Provide overview of the train management subsystem including ATS data processing, driver assignment, track circuit occupancy, and train tracking displays

pages.title: Train State Management and Driver Assignment
pages.purpose: Document the TrainService's complex state machine with 8 rejection scenarios, conflict detection (IsOnPreviousTrain, IsTherePreviousTrain, IsMaybeWarp, IsLocked), driver handoff logic, and train number changes

pages.title: Track Circuit Detection and Management
pages.purpose: Explain track circuit occupancy detection, bulk update operations via ExecuteUpdateAsync, locking mechanisms for routes, and unlock timer management

pages.title: Real-time Communication Layer
pages.purpose: Provide overview of the SignalR-based real-time communication architecture supporting bidirectional communication with multiple client types

pages.title: SignalR Hub Architecture and Contracts
pages.purpose: Document the SignalR hubs used for train operation, CTCP, TID and the commander table, and their contracts. Do not describe InterlockingHub internals.

pages.title: Train Hub and ATS Interface
pages.purpose: Document TrainHub's SendData_ATS method, AtsToServerData and ServerToATSData DTOs, scheduled broadcasts (ServerToATSDataBySchedule every 250ms), and status flag system

pages.title: Display and Commander Hubs
pages.purpose: Document CTCPHub for centralized traffic control panel data, TIDHub for train information displays, and CommanderTableHub for administrative operations (DeleteTrain, SetServerMode, track circuit management)

pages.title: System Infrastructure
pages.purpose: Provide overview of application startup, database initialization, background processing, and authentication systems

pages.title: Application Bootstrap and Configuration
pages.purpose: Document Program.cs for Crew and Passenger applications, service registration, middleware configuration, OpenIddict setup, and hub endpoint mapping

pages.title: Database Initialization Pipeline
pages.purpose: Document the 25-phase DatabaseInitializationOrchestrator process, CSV loading (StationCsvLoader, TrackCircuitCsvLoader, SignalCsvLoader, etc.), DbRendoTableInitializer's complex lock parsing, and entity detachment strategy

pages.title: Background Scheduler System
pages.purpose: Document SchedulerManager's coordination of background schedulers (SignalScheduler, TrainScheduler, CTCPHubScheduler, CommanderTableHubScheduler, InterlockingHubScheduler, TIDHubScheduler, OperationNotificationScheduler, DestinationButtonScheduler) with 250-500ms intervals

pages.title: Authentication and Authorization
pages.purpose: Document OpenIddict OAuth2/OpenID Connect setup with Discord provider, authorization policies (TrainPolicy, InterlockingPolicy, CommanderTablePolicy), role-based access (IsDriver, IsConductor, IsSignalman, IsCommander), and MemberID extraction

pages.title: Server Mode and State Management
pages.purpose: Document ServerService's management of ServerState (Mode: Off/Private/Public, TimeOffset, SwitchMoveTime), mutex-based concurrency control, and SchedulerManager integration

pages.title: Configuration Data and Models
pages.purpose: Provide overview of CSV configuration files, data models, and domain entities used throughout the system

pages.title: Database Schema and Entity Model
pages.purpose: Document the database schema for stations, track circuits, signals, trains, diagrams and server state. Do not document relay/interlocking logic tables or TTC tables.

pages.title: CSV Data Files
pages.purpose: Document the CSV file formats for stations, track circuits, signals and trains. Do not document RendoTable CSVs or TTC CSVs.

pages.title: Data Models and Domain Entities
pages.purpose: Document core domain models for trains, track circuits, signals, stations and diagrams. Do not document relay/route/lever/TTC models.

pages.title: Repository and Data Access Layer
pages.purpose: Provide overview of the repository pattern implementation with 40+ repositories providing data access abstraction over Entity Framework Core

pages.title: Repository Pattern and Interfaces
pages.purpose: Document the repository pattern architecture, interface definitions, ApplicationDbContext usage, and common patterns like ExecuteUpdateAsync for bulk operations and Include() for eager loading
